_comment: MOCK DATA: ClauseGuard standardized mock scan response for testing. Does not contain real service scores.

clauses.meaning: Provides a 14-day refund window for digital purchases upon customer request.
clauses.what_you_can_do: Contact customer support within 14 days of purchase if you require a refund.
clauses.excerpt: You may request a full refund within 14 days of your initial purchase by contacting customer support.

clauses.meaning: Subscriptions can be cancelled anytime and remain active until the billing cycle ends.
clauses.what_you_can_do: Cancel your subscription in account settings before your next renewal date.
clauses.excerpt: You can cancel your recurring subscription at any time from your account settings page.

clauses.meaning: You can request complete deletion of your account and personal records.
clauses.what_you_can_do: Submit an account deletion request through your privacy settings dashboard.
clauses.excerpt: Users may permanently delete their account and associated data through the privacy settings panel.

clauses.meaning: Shares device identifiers and usage telemetry with external analytics and advertising partners.
clauses.what_you_can_do: Turn off non-essential tracking cookies in cookie preferences.
clauses.excerpt: We disclose usage information and device identifiers to trusted third-party advertising partners.

clauses.meaning: Uses browsing history and cookie data to deliver personalized advertising across websites.
clauses.what_you_can_do: Opt out of targeted advertising in your account settings.
clauses.excerpt: Our partners may collect web browsing activity to serve interest-based advertisements across other sites.
